info.name: OpenGov Purchase Order Admin Settings API
Get admin settings for an entity

params.name: entityId
params.description: The UUID of the Platform entity

items.docs: Returns entity-level admin settings. Creates a row with defaults (allowOverInvoicing=false, autoIssueOnPromotion=false) on first call so the response always includes id/createdAt/updatedAt.

info.name: Update admin settings for an entity

params.name: entityId
params.description: The UUID of the Platform entity

items.docs: Creates or partially updates entity-level admin settings (upsert). Omitted fields retain their existing value or default. Returns the persisted settings.
